description: A paused account and what it takes to restore it.

deletionScheduledAt.description: When unfunded content is scheduled for deletion. Published and permanently absent: this is the regional content lifecycle's fact and that authority does not exist yet.

minimumRestoreCents.description: Smallest top-up that restores service. Present exactly when `reason` is `top_up_required`; the other three holds have no paying remedy, and naming an amount for them would be a false one.

retentionFundedUntil.description: How long retained content stays funded. Published and permanently absent: storage is billed monthly and unfunded storage is enforced through the account pause, so no authority owns this instant yet.

title: AccountPausedState
